cases.purpose: tz now -z ZONE prints the current local time consistent with GNU date at the same instant
cases.oracle: GNU date (coreutils) in the guest with the guest tzdata, sampled before and after the candidate to bracket the instant
cases.comparison: Candidate wall-clock string lies between two GNU samples and its abbreviation/offset equals GNU's for five zones.
cases.script:
[[ $UID == 2000 && $EUID == 2000 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r marker </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
IFS= read -r vendor </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
[[ $vendor == QEMU && $marker =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
[[ $(type -t tz) == builtin ]] || exit 125
for z in UTC America/New_York Europe/Berlin Australia/Sydney Asia/Tokyo; do
  g1=$(TZ=$z /usr/bin/date +'%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
  tz now -z "$z" -V out; rc=$?
  g2=$(TZ=$z /usr/bin/date +'%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z %z')
  c=${out:0:19}; t2=${g2:0:19}
  within=0; [[ ! $c < $g1 && ! $c > $t2 ]] && within=1
  suffix=0; [[ ${out:20} == "${g2:20}" ]] && suffix=1
  echo "$z: rc=$rc within-gnu-bracket=$within suffix-equals-gnu=$suffix"
done
cases.stdout:
UTC: rc=0 within-gnu-bracket=1 suffix-equals-gnu=1
America/New_York: rc=0 within-gnu-bracket=1 suffix-equals-gnu=1
Europe/Berlin: rc=0 within-gnu-bracket=1 suffix-equals-gnu=1
Australia/Sydney: rc=0 within-gnu-bracket=1 suffix-equals-gnu=1
Asia/Tokyo: rc=0 within-gnu-bracket=1 suffix-equals-gnu=1

cases.purpose: tz info ZONE reports the offset and abbreviation in effect now
cases.oracle: GNU date (coreutils) in the guest with the guest tzdata, sampled before and after the candidate to bracket the instant; rule names from the zone's published DST regime (US, EU, AU, none)
cases.comparison: name, offset and abbreviation equal GNU date's %z/%Z (equal before and after) and the rule label matches the regime, for five zones.
cases.script:
[[ $UID == 2000 && $EUID == 2000 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r marker </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
IFS= read -r vendor </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
[[ $vendor == QEMU && $marker =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
[[ $(type -t tz) == builtin ]] || exit 125
declare -A RULE=([UTC]=fixed [America/New_York]=us [Europe/Berlin]=eu [Australia/Sydney]=au [Asia/Tokyo]=fixed)
for z in UTC America/New_York Europe/Berlin Australia/Sydney Asia/Tokyo; do
  a1=$(TZ=$z /usr/bin/date +'%z %Z')
  out=$(tz info "$z"); rc=$?
  a2=$(TZ=$z /usr/bin/date +'%z %Z')
  mapfile -t L <<<"$out"
  [[ $a1 == "$a2" ]] || exit 97
  set -- $a1
  nm=0; [[ ${L[0]} == "name=$z" ]] && nm=1
  of=0; [[ ${L[1]} == "offset=$1" ]] && of=1
  ab=0; [[ ${L[2]} == "abbr=$2" ]] && ab=1
  ru=0; [[ ${L[3]} == "rule=${RULE[$z]}" ]] && ru=1
  echo "$z: rc=$rc name=$nm offset=$of abbr=$ab rule=$ru lines=${#L[@]}"
done
cases.stdout:
UTC: rc=0 name=1 offset=1 abbr=1 rule=1 lines=4
America/New_York: rc=0 name=1 offset=1 abbr=1 rule=1 lines=4
Europe/Berlin: rc=0 name=1 offset=1 abbr=1 rule=1 lines=4
Australia/Sydney: rc=0 name=1 offset=1 abbr=1 rule=1 lines=4
Asia/Tokyo: rc=0 name=1 offset=1 abbr=1 rule=1 lines=4

cases.purpose: tz now and tz info on both sides of the 2024 US and EU DST transitions with CLOCK_REALTIME set by root
cases.oracle: Transition instants from the US (second Sunday of March 07:00Z, first Sunday of November 06:00Z for New York) and EU (last Sunday 01:00Z) rules, with GNU date and the guest tzdata as cross-check
cases.comparison: Local time prefix, abbreviation and offset on each side of four transitions.
cases.script:
[[ $UID == 0 && $EUID == 0 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r marker </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
IFS= read -r vendor </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
[[ $vendor == QEMU && $marker =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
[[ $(type -t tz) == builtin ]] || exit 125
chk() { # label zone utc-instant local-prefix abbr offset
  /usr/bin/date -u -s "$3" >/dev/null || exit 97
  tz now -z "$2" -V out
  info=$(tz info "$2"); mapfile -t L <<<"$info"
  g=$(TZ=$2 /usr/bin/date +'%Z %z')
  nowok=0; [[ $out == "${3%% *} "* ]] || true
  lp=${out:11:7}; lok=0; [[ $lp == "$4" ]] && lok=1
  echo "$1: now-local=$lok now-suffix=${out:20} info-abbr=${L[2]#abbr=} info-offset=${L[1]#offset=} gnu=$g"
}
chk NY-spring-before America/New_York "2024-03-10 06:59:50" 01:59:5 EST -0500
chk NY-spring-after America/New_York "2024-03-10 07:00:05" 03:00:0 EDT -0400
chk NY-fall-before America/New_York "2024-11-03 05:59:50" 01:59:5 EDT -0400
chk NY-fall-after America/New_York "2024-11-03 06:00:05" 01:00:0 EST -0500
chk Berlin-spring-before Europe/Berlin "2024-03-31 00:59:50" 01:59:5 CET +0100
chk Berlin-spring-after Europe/Berlin "2024-03-31 01:00:05" 03:00:0 CEST +0200
chk Berlin-fall-before Europe/Berlin "2024-10-27 00:59:50" 02:59:5 CEST +0200
chk Berlin-fall-after Europe/Berlin "2024-10-27 01:00:05" 02:00:0 CET +0100
cases.stdout:
NY-spring-before: now-local=1 now-suffix=EST -0500 info-abbr=EST info-offset=-0500 gnu=EST -0500
NY-spring-after: now-local=1 now-suffix=EDT -0400 info-abbr=EDT info-offset=-0400 gnu=EDT -0400
NY-fall-before: now-local=1 now-suffix=EDT -0400 info-abbr=EDT info-offset=-0400 gnu=EDT -0400
NY-fall-after: now-local=1 now-suffix=EST -0500 info-abbr=EST info-offset=-0500 gnu=EST -0500
Berlin-spring-before: now-local=1 now-suffix=CET +0100 info-abbr=CET info-offset=+0100 gnu=CET +0100
Berlin-spring-after: now-local=1 now-suffix=CEST +0200 info-abbr=CEST info-offset=+0200 gnu=CEST +0200
Berlin-fall-before: now-local=1 now-suffix=CEST +0200 info-abbr=CEST info-offset=+0200 gnu=CEST +0200
Berlin-fall-after: now-local=1 now-suffix=CET +0100 info-abbr=CET info-offset=+0100 gnu=CET +0100
